newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London firm, buyback ups Sakura.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London firm, buyback ups Sakura.

text.p: Japanese shares in London firmed slightly on Monday amid strong interest in Sakura Cor, which announced Japan's first buy-back of shares.
The Nikkei/ISE 50 Index ended 1.61 points, or 0.10 percent, higher to close at 1,602.73 points.
Earlier the Nikkei 225 in Tokyo rose 50.60 points, or 0.25 percent, to 20,436.14 points as the Yen eased against the dollar after the G7 meeting in Denver.
"There was not much trading, traders just marked up prices in the morning. Just Sakura was exiting", one dealer said.
Earlier this afternoon, the bank said it would seek the shareholders' agreement for purchasing and retiring shares. It would limit the purchase to 350 million shares it said.
The stock rose 4.50 yen to 867.50 yen, compared with a close of 842 yen in Tokyo.
Sakura was the most actively traded share in London, dealers said.
Elsewhere, exporters were said to have gained on the weakening of the yen.
Fujitsu rose 22.5 yen to 1,590 yen but unchanged against it's Tokyo close.
